subject: Module API: what ModuleHost must offer
body: contracts/API.md (M1) will define onboarding.run(host), sensing.start(profile, onEvent, onFrame?), sensing.record(emotionId, seconds), reps.run(profile, emotionId, trigger, host), reps.progress(sessions). I need one thing: what the host slot you hand a module looks like (a DOM element? a speak() function? onSafetyStop?). Until you answer I'll define ModuleHost as {el: HTMLElement, speak?(text), onSafetyStop()}.
